resources.string: Particles flowing through a field of attractors. Each piece paints itself, then holds still.
Generative art: particles flowing through a field of attractors. A piece paints itself over a few seconds, then holds still and costs nothing to display.
Following the system paints on your accent color in the light theme, and on black — which an OLED screen does not have to light up — in the dark one. Pick any other set to opt out.
Particles flow around this text. Leave it empty for a plain field.
Only changes how often the piece is shown while it paints. It takes the same time to finish either way.
Double tap the home screen to paint a new piece.
Show fewer frames while the device is saving power.
